title: The Water Element: Meaning, Years and Personality in the Chinese Zodiac
seo_title: Water Element in the Chinese Zodiac: Meaning, Years, Personality
description: What the Water element means in the Chinese five elements: its season, direction and colour, every Water year from 1944 to 2035, how Water relates to the other elements, and the Water personality.
lead: Water is one of the five elements of Chinese tradition, alongside Wood, Fire, Earth and Metal. Here is what Water stands for, which birth years belong to it, and how it works with the other four elements.
card_text: What the Water element means, every Water year from 1944 to 2035, and the Water personality.

paras: Think of a river finding its way around rocks, or a deep, still lake at night: soft on the surface, powerful underneath, always moving towards the lowest and easiest path. Water is the element of winter, of rest and of the quiet stored energy that comes before spring. Its qualities are depth, flexibility and calm.

In Chinese the five elements are called wuxing, and Water is shui. As Wikipedia's article on wuxing notes, the word was first translated into English as the Five Elements, but the idea is less about physical substances than about processes and change. That is why some scholars prefer translations such as five phases or five agents. Water is best understood as a stage in a cycle, a kind of energy, rather than only a material.
Traditional Chinese cosmology links each element with a season, a direction, a colour and more. The New World Encyclopedia lists these correspondences for Water:

paras: Every Chinese year is named by pairing one of ten Heavenly Stems with one of twelve Earthly Branches, the system the Hong Kong Observatory describes in its guide to the stems and branches. The branch gives the year's animal; the stem gives its element. Two stems belong to Water: Ren, the yang form, and Gui, the yin form, as the table of stems in Wikipedia's article on the sexagenary cycle shows.

Because the ten stems repeat every ten years, each element covers two years in a row, once a decade. Wikipedia notes that 1984 was a Jia-zi year, the start of the present sixty-year cycle; counting from there gives a simple rule: Water years end in 2 or 3. One important detail: the Chinese year starts at Chinese New Year, in late January or February, not on 1 January. Someone born in January 2022, before that year's Chinese New Year, still belongs to the previous year and its element. Our zodiac sign checker uses the exact new-year date for every year.

paras: Each element appears twice in the cycle, once in a yang form and once in a yin form. Ren years are yang Water, and they always fall on yang animals (Rat, Tiger, Dragon, Horse, Monkey and Dog). Gui years are yin Water, and they always fall on yin animals (Ox, Rabbit, Snake, Goat, Rooster and Pig). In the list above, the years ending in 2 are yang and the years ending in 3 are yin.
Yang is traditionally the more outward, active side and yin the more inward, receptive side. Neither is better than the other: both are needed, and every element moves between them.

sections.h2: How Water works with the other elements
paras: The five elements are linked by two traditional cycles, which the New World Encyclopedia and Wikipedia both describe. In the generating cycle, each element feeds the next: Wood feeds Fire, Fire creates Earth, Earth bears Metal, Metal carries Water and Water nourishes Wood. In the overcoming cycle, each element keeps another in check: Wood parts Earth, Earth absorbs Water, Water quenches Fire, Fire melts Metal and Metal chops Wood. For Water, that means:
list: Metal supports Water: Metal carries Water, as dew gathers on a cool metal surface or a bucket holds water.
Water supports Wood: Water nourishes Wood, just as rain makes plants grow.
Earth restrains Water: Earth absorbs Water, as river banks and dams hold a flood.
after: In compatibility readings, elements that follow each other in the generating cycle are traditionally said to support each other, and those linked by the overcoming cycle are said to need more balance. Our five elements guide shows both cycles for all five elements, and the compatibility calculator compares the signs of any two birth dates.

paras: In our readings on this site, the Water element describes a style of energy that colours a person's zodiac sign. We describe it like this: Water is the element of the river: always moving, always finding the path of least resistance. People born in a Water year tend to read a room before they speak in it, adapting their approach to whoever they're with. That makes them excellent diplomats and quietly persuasive communicators. The risk is passivity: Water personalities can drift along with a situation they should have pushed back on sooner.

Remember that the element is only one part of a traditional reading, alongside the animal, yin or yang, and in fuller readings the month, day and hour of birth. Two people with the same element can be very different, and the zodiac is a cultural tradition for reflection and fun, not a scientific test of character.
Whatever your own element, traditional advice uses Water as a reminder of certain qualities:
list: Rest and reflect: winter is Water's season, so traditional advice links it with learning, listening and recharging.
Go around obstacles: like a river, the easy path is often the wise one.
Don't drift: flexibility works best with a clear direction.

faq: Which years are Water years in the Chinese zodiac?
Years ending in 2 or 3, for example 2012, 2013, 2032 and 2033. The year starts at Chinese New Year, so January and early February births may belong to the previous year.
What season, direction and colour go with Water?
Traditionally Water goes with winter, north and black.
Metal, in the generating cycle: Metal carries Water, as dew gathers on a cool metal surface or a bucket holds water. Water in turn supports Wood.
Is my element the same as my zodiac animal?

No. Your animal comes from the year's Earthly Branch and your element from its Heavenly Stem. Each animal can have any of the five elements, so the same animal and element combination returns only every sixty years.
